title: Apimeds Pharmaceuticals US, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-16
summary: Apimeds Pharmaceuticals US, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on April 16, 2026, disclosing its inability to timely file its Annual Report on Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. The company cited ongoing preparation of financial statements and audit completion as reasons for the delay, with an expected filing date of April 30, 2026. The company anticipates receiving a non-compliance notice from NYSE American.
key_points: Company: Apimeds Pharmaceuticals US, Inc. (ticker: APUS, NYSE American)
Filed Form 12b-25 Notification of Late Filing on March 31, 2026 for Form 10-K covering fiscal year ended December 31, 2025
Delay attributed to finalization of Q4 and FY2025 financial statements and completion of audit procedures by independent registered public accounting firm
Company expects to receive NYSE American non-compliance notice due to failure to timely file Form 10-K
Company expects to file Form 10-K by April 30, 2026, though no assurance of meeting that date
Registrant is an emerging growth company as defined in Rule 405 of the Securities Act
